purpose: One stable boot for fresh or parallel agents. Runtime compiles the smallest current work packet so agents spend effort on product reasoning instead of repository archaeology.

hard_commands.Prometeo: Resync from this entry, infer the current/previous unfinished intent, load one compiled packet, reconcile only new deltas, choose the proper execution profile, continue the work, and print the Prometeo Seal only after successful load.
Continue the active packet execution frontier without regenerating settled context, title maps or specifications.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should be operating under Prometeo has no violet seal, the user may send only `Prometeo` to force resync/recovery.

fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, fall back to NOW/PACK/LAST_RETURN/delta routing. Do not ask the human to reconstruct context until durable recovery paths have failed.
truth: Entry/runtime coordinate agents only; they do not grant Current, Served, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
